text:
leah: Quick heads-up from onboarding session: the quickstart broke because the sample app expects REDWOOD_KEY but the SDK looks for REDWOOD_API_KEY. New hires got stuck for 10m.

owen: Ack. We've been sloppy here. We should pick a single canonical env var and propagate it everywhere. My vote: REDWOOD_API_KEY.

mica: Agreed. Also we should be explicit about scope envs: REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT. Embedding project in the key string has caused confusion.

sam: Parity note: Go sampleapp still reads REDWOOD_TOKEN. Will patch to accept REDWOOD_API_KEY with a deprecation warning for REDWOOD_TOKEN.

leah: Can we add a lightweight cred-lint check to CI that flags unknown env names? Would catch this before onboarding.

owen: Yep, I'll add a shellcheck-style rule (cred-lint) to the repo. It should trigger on PRs that touch sample apps.

mica: Rotation: recommend we support a session exchange flow for CI. Endpoint POST /v1/sessions returns short-lived token rs_..., exchange using long-lived rk_ key. We should document and include scripts/sampleapp/ci_rotate.sh.

sam: On retry behavior: SDKs must not auto-retry on 401. Instead return an AuthError with hint "try_refresh" boolean. JS currently retries 401 once because retry policy lumps auth with transient errors.

leah: Telemetry idea: emit a single event auth.rotation_suspected when client sees 401 with an Authorization header present. That helps ops detect mass expirations.

owen: Will update JS retry policy and add the telemetry ping. Also will make the SDK emit a one-line deprecation log if REDWOOD_TOKEN is present.

mica: I'll update docs to call out env precedence: CLI flag > REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_KEY/REDWOOD_TOKEN (deprecated) > credentials file. Also add examples for bash and docker run.

dev-tools-bot: docs link: https://redwood.example/internal/devtools/auth-ux (auto)

sam: I'll draft scripts/ci_rotate.sh and add README snippet for CI pipelines. Will also include a minimal curl example: 
```
# exchange rk_ for rs_
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/sessions -H "Authorization: rk_XXX" | jq -r .token > .session_token
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat .session_token)
```

leah: Perfect. Action list: 1) Docs PR to standardize REDWOOD_API_KEY + scope envs, 2) SDK patches to accept fallbacks but warn, 3) change JS retry logic to not retry 401, 4) add cred-lint rule, 5) add sample CI rotation script. Who takes what?

owen: I'll do JS + cred-lint.

mica: Docs + policy.

sam: Sampleapp script + python SDK patch.

leah: Thanks — let's aim to land this before next onboarding wave.
